question: 统计orders表中共有多少条订单记录
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

question: 计算所有状态为「已完成」的订单的支付总金额
sql: SELECT SUM(pay_amount) AS total_paid_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 3;

question: 计算所有订单的平均订单金额和平均支付金额
sql: SELECT AVG(order_amount) AS avg_order_amount, AVG(pay_amount) AS avg_pay_amount FROM orders;

question: 查询单笔订单金额最高的订单编号和金额
sql: SELECT id, order_amount FROM orders ORDER BY order_amount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 统计收货地址为NULL或空字符串的异常订单数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS abnormal_address_count FROM orders WHERE shipping_address IS NULL OR shipping_address = '';

question: 计算所有订单的累计优惠总金额（订单金额减去支付金额的差额之和）
sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount - pay_amount) AS total_discount FROM orders;

question: 按订单状态分组统计各状态的订单数量，按数量从多到少排列
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: 统计每个用户的下单数量，列出下单最多的前10名用户及其订单数
sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 按月份统计每月的订单总金额趋势，按时间升序排列
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(order_amount) AS monthly_total FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: 分别统计VIP用户（user_id在1001到1100之间）和普通用户（user_id在1101到3000之间）的平均订单金额
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN user_id BETWEEN 1001 AND 1100 THEN 'VIP' ELSE '普通用户' END AS user_type, AVG(order_amount) AS avg_amount FROM orders GROUP BY user_type;

question: 按日期统计最近30天每天的订单量，按日期升序排列
sql: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

question: 按订单状态统计已支付订单（status>=1）的平均支付比例（pay_amount/order_amount），按比例降序排列
sql: SELECT status, AVG(pay_amount / order_amount) AS avg_pay_ratio FROM orders WHERE status >= 1 GROUP BY status ORDER BY avg_pay_ratio DESC;

question: 查询订单金额超过500元且状态为「待支付」的订单编号、金额和创建时间
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, create_time FROM orders WHERE order_amount > 500 AND status = 0;

question: 查询状态为「已发货」或「已完成」的订单中，支付金额不到订单金额80%的订单编号和金额
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, pay_amount FROM orders WHERE status IN (2, 3) AND pay_amount < order_amount * 0.8;

question: 将订单按金额分为「小额（<100）」「中额（100-500）」「大额（>500）」三档，统计各档订单数量
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_amount < 100 THEN '小额' WHEN order_amount BETWEEN 100 AND 500 THEN '中额' ELSE '大额' END AS amount_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY amount_level;

question: 查询VIP用户（user_id在1001到1100之间）中状态为「已取消」的订单编号、金额和用户ID
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, user_id FROM orders WHERE user_id BETWEEN 1001 AND 1100 AND status = 4;

question: 查询收货地址不为空、订单金额在100到1000之间、且支付金额不到订单金额90%的订单
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, pay_amount, shipping_address FROM orders WHERE shipping_address IS NOT NULL AND shipping_address != '' AND order_amount BETWEEN 100 AND 1000 AND pay_amount < order_amount * 0.9;

question: 查询状态为「已退款」（status=5）且订单金额超过1000元的订单编号、金额和创建时间
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, create_time FROM orders WHERE status = 5 AND order_amount > 1000;

question: 统计最近7天内创建的订单总数和订单总金额
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY;

question: 统计上个月（2026年6月）每天的订单数量和总金额
sql: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(order_amount) AS daily_amount FROM orders WHERE create_time >= '2026-06-01' AND create_time < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

question: 统计本月（2026年7月）已支付订单的总数和支付总金额
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_count, SUM(pay_amount) AS total_paid FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND pay_time >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00' AND pay_time < '2026-08-01 00:00:00';

question: 按小时（0-23）统计所有订单的创建数量分布
sql: SELECT HOUR(create_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour;

question: 计算所有已支付订单从创建到支付的平均时间间隔（以小时为单位）
sql: SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, pay_time)) AS avg_pay_hours FROM orders WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND status >= 1;

question: 按周统计近3个月每周的订单数量趋势
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%x-%v') AS week, COUNT(*) AS weekly_orders FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) GROUP BY week ORDER BY week;

question: 查询订单金额高于所有订单平均金额的订单编号、用户ID和金额
sql: SELECT id, user_id, order_amount FROM orders WHERE order_amount > (SELECT AVG(order_amount) FROM orders);

question: 查询下单数量最多的用户的最近5笔订单的编号、金额、状态和创建时间
sql: SELECT id, order_amount, status, create_time FROM orders WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM orders GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询从未支付过的用户（即所有订单状态均为「待支付」的用户）的ID列表
sql: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM orders o1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.user_id = o1.user_id AND o2.status >= 1);

question: 帮我删除orders表中所有状态为「已取消」的订单数据
sql: DELETE FROM orders WHERE status = 4;

question: 把user_id为1001的用户的所有订单状态批量改为「已完成」
sql: UPDATE orders SET status = 3 WHERE user_id = 1001;

question: 清空orders表的所有数据
sql: TRUNCATE TABLE orders;
